scope: status-inspection timeout root-cause fix; source + gates only, deployment separate
symptom: daemon logs 'status_failed: status inspection timed out' for browser-extensions-shared and dracon-platform
rootCause: dracon-sync builds each epoch private index with git read-tree (no stat data) and installs it over the real index; without stat data every tracked file must be re-run through warden clean filter on the next status

fix.approach: start from the CURRENT index, apply only the (mode,oid,path) delta via git update-index -z --index-info, verify the merged index equals the private index via git ls-files --stage, else fall back to installing verbatim
fix.safety: stat data is only retained for entries whose mode and oid are unchanged; git re-validates size/mtime before trusting it, so stale stat can only cost a hash; conflicted (stage != 0) indexes are never merged

regression: installing_an_epoch_index_keeps_the_stat_cache_of_unchanged_entries - starts warm (0 zeroed), installs a read-tree index, asserts 0 zeroed afterwards, asserts write-tree unchanged and that a real content edit is still reported
flakes: git::staged_intent::tests::shared_git_runner_deadline_and_drop_terminate_owned_descendant read the helper pid file between create and write under load 34-46; passes alone
sync::excluded_revert::crash_tests::excluded_recovery_parent_crash_kills_actual_lease_holder_without_late_restores passed 3/3 alone under the same load

environmentRepairPerformed.note: reversible, content-neutral; used because the daemon keeping the cache warm was the defect being fixed
